# veadotube triggers

## Avatar state changed

Runs when your avatar changes to another state in veadotube, whether you clicked it, used a hotkey, or an action changed it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **States** | Only react when the avatar changes to one of these states. Type their names as in veadotube, separated by commas. Leave empty for any state. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%veadotube.instance%` | The name of the veadotube that is connected (for example veadotube mini) |
| `%veadotube.instanceId%` | veadotube's own id for that window |
| `%state%` | The state now showing |
| `%stateId%` | That state's id (the same as its name in new versions) |
| `%previousState%` | The state that was showing before |
| `%nodeName%` | The node that changed (avatar state in veadotube mini) |
| `%nodeId%` | That node's id |

<small>Type id: `veadotube.stateChanged`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to veadotube.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%veadotube.instance%` | The name of the veadotube that is connected (for example veadotube mini) |
| `%veadotube.instanceId%` | veadotube's own id for that window |

<small>Type id: `veadotube.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when the connection to veadotube drops, for example because you closed it.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%veadotube.instance%` | The name of the veadotube that is connected (for example veadotube mini) |
| `%veadotube.instanceId%` | veadotube's own id for that window |
| `%reason%` | Why it dropped |

<small>Type id: `veadotube.disconnected`</small>

## Push-to-talk (on/off node) changed

Runs when push-to-talk (or another on/off node in full veadotube) turns on or off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Nodes** | Only react to these nodes, for example push-to-talk. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any. |
| **Turned** | Only react when it turns On, only when it turns Off, or Any. Options: Any, On, Off. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%veadotube.instance%` | The name of the veadotube that is connected (for example veadotube mini) |
| `%veadotube.instanceId%` | veadotube's own id for that window |
| `%nodeName%` | The node that changed, for example push-to-talk |
| `%nodeId%` | That node's id |
| `%value%` | True when it is now on, false when off |
| `%state%` | On or Off |

<small>Type id: `veadotube.switchChanged`</small>
